title: Project X Hub
features:
Aimbot – Activate the automatic targeting system on the nearest target inside the FOV.

Aim Part – It allows you to select the body part that will be prioritized (Head or Torso).

Aim Key – Set the keybind used to activate the aimbot.

Smoothness – Adjusts the smoothing of the sight movement (the bigger, more natural and less abrupt).

Trigger Bot – Fire automatically when the target is in sight.

Wall Check – It prevents the imbot/trigger from working when the enemy is behind walls or obstacles.

Circle FOV – Displays a circle on the screen indicating the area of action of the embot.

FOV Size – Slider to adjust FOV size.

ESP Players – Activates the players' view through screen highlights.

Show Outline – Adds contour to players for better visibility.

Box Thickness – Adjusts the thickness of ESP boxes.

ESP Color Box – Allows you to change the color of ESP boxes.
